title: API Domain
summary: Design, secure, scale, and evolve REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and event-driven APIs with a contract-first workflow.
philosophy: API work is contract-driven and security-first. Protect consumers from breaking changes, design authentication before endpoints go public, and never trade backward compatibility for speed in a public API.

protocol-selector.role: Chooses REST, GraphQL, gRPC, or event-driven based on latency, payload, and client needs.

contract-first-designer.role: Writes the OpenAPI/AsyncAPI contract before code.

api-mock-designer.role: Builds stateful mock servers from the contract.

sdk-scaffolder.role: Scaffolds idiomatic client SDKs from the contract.

auth-flow-designer.role: Selects API keys, JWT, OAuth2, or mTLS and designs token lifecycles and scopes.

rate-limit-strategist.role: Designs throttling algorithms, quotas, and 429 responses.

breaking-change-detector.role: Diffs two contract versions and classifies breaking changes.

changelog-generator.role: Turns contract diffs and commits into consumer-facing changelogs.

webhook-architect.role: Designs outbound webhook payloads, signing, retries, and DLQ.

api-observability-planner.role: Defines metrics, structured logs, tracing, and alerts for the API boundary.

steps.do: Decide the protocol when it is not already fixed.
steps.done_when: One protocol chosen with trade-offs recorded.

steps.do: Write the OpenAPI/AsyncAPI contract: resources, schemas, errors, versioning.
steps.done_when: Contract passes a spec linter and covers every endpoint in scope.

steps.do: Generate stateful mocks and example payloads from the contract.
steps.done_when: Consumers can exercise happy and error paths against the mock.

steps.do: Scaffold typed client SDKs with retry, timeout, and pagination.
steps.done_when: SDK compiles and matches the contract.

workflows.title: API Security & Scale Flow
when: prepare the API for high traffic

steps.do: Design authentication, token lifecycle, and authorization scopes.
steps.done_when: Every endpoint has an auth requirement and scope.

steps.do: Design rate limits and quotas per user, key, and IP.
steps.done_when: Limits, headers, and 429 behavior are specified.

steps.do: Audit agent-facing or skill-facing surfaces when bots or agents call the API.
steps.condition: Agents or external bots consume the API

steps.do: Diff the old and new contracts and classify MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH changes.
steps.done_when: Every change is classified and breaking changes have a migration path.

steps.do: Publish a consumer-facing changelog and deprecation notices.
steps.done_when: Changelog lists features, fixes, and deprecations with dates.

steps.do: Design outbound webhooks: envelope, signing, retries, DLQ.
steps.done_when: Delivery is async, signed, idempotent, and retried.
steps.condition: The API emits events to consumers

steps.do: Define RED metrics, structured logs, tracing, and SLO alerts.
steps.done_when: Each critical endpoint has metrics, traces, and an alert.

handoffs.when: Authorization must also be enforced in the database (RLS)
